summary: A self-taught Senior Front-End Developer with 7+ years of experience. Expert in React Native/Expo for mobile apps and React.js/Next.js for web applications. Passionate about delivering pixel-perfect UIs, clean architecture, and exceptional user experiences.
about:
I'm currently working as a Senior Front-End Developer at OPTISANTIS, based in Grenoble, France. With over 7 years of professional experience, I wear two hats: building high-performance mobile applications with React Native/Expo and crafting web experiences with Next.js and React.js. 
 I've successfully published multiple mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play, and I specialize in architecture, performance optimization, native bridging, and the complete app lifecycle. On the web side, I focus on accessibility (RGAA), SEO, and design systems. 
 I'm passionate about building clean, scalable, and maintainable applications with a strong focus on code quality, using tools like ESLint, Prettier, and TypeScript. 
 Beyond writing code, I thrive on continuous improvement and sharing knowledge with the community. 
 Scroll down to explore the projects I've been working on.
